w: Swamishri was honored by the President of Botswana, H.E. Festus G. Mogae, at the State House. Swamishri blessed him and the country for progress and success. The President said his country allowed freedom of worship and he was honored to welcome him.

At 6.25pm Swamishri addressed an assembly of doctors offering honorary services in the mandir, "Our shastras say that one who has self-control suffers less diseases. Because when man does not exercise any discipline in eating, drinking, looking, hearing, etc. And the unseen elements (of anger, jealousy, greed, lust) within are more responsible for his sufferings. They cannot be detected by a stethoscope. The shastras prescribe refuge in God as the only cure. The more self-control one has the more peace and happiness one will have in life. And along with self-control one should also associate with a holy sadhu (sant samagam). Prayers too have cured chronic diseases..."

Prasad Pravesh & Kalash Vidhi To begin the inauguration of the second traditional Hindu mandir in America, Swamishri performed the Prasad Pravesh, or the first official entry into the mandir, and kalash pujan vidhi after completing his morning puja.
6 August Vishvashanti Mahayagna
7 August Nagar Yatra
8 August Murti Pratishtha

During the meetings there is always a struggle for time, because every day the number of devotees is always greater than the meetings that can be given in the set time. In this very context, when Pramukh Swami Maharaj came into his room, Harivallabh Swami said, "God is one and the devotees are many. What can be done? How can he reach them all?"
Swamishri said, "God is one, but he is able to reach everywhere. He is in water, on land, everywhere! If one has knowledge, he is seen everywhere, otherwise he is not seen."

During the meal, the sadhus of the Anand mandir had the benefit of darshan. After the meal, when everyone stood up, touched Pramukh Swami Maharaj's feet and took leave, the sadhus called Purnaswarup Swami and said, "There are devotees from very old families, and this Purnaswarup Swami takes great care of all of them. He calls them to the mandir, and makes a point of calling them so that they come to the arti and the assembly. He looks after them well. He has got everyone coming to the mandir."
Swamishri was pleased with this quality of his and said, "New people come, but the old ones drift away. So make a special point of calling all of them."
Having said this, he went on remembering the families of devotees living in Anand from the time of Shastriji Maharaj. Swamishri went on remembering them for about fifteen to twenty minutes.

After the meal, one phone call came after another. Pramukh Swami Maharaj wanted to hold a meeting, but that did not become possible. Sandeep Dhir phoned from Mombasa. Even in the midst of so much activity, Swamishri said to Sandeep Dhir, "Speak in your own language." Sandeep is originally Punjabi, so he spoke to Swamishri in Punjabi. In this way Swamishri showed how he remembers.
Even though he is in contact with lakhs (hundreds of thousands) of devotees, Swamishri knows who is where and what each one's particular traits are. Swamishri also knows how to please each person.

Mahant Swami Maharaj and the senior sadhus wished to proclaim publicly the acclaim won for the "Akshar Purushottam Siddhant" through Bhadreshdas Swami. For this, a letter had been prepared according to Swamishri's wishes. It was read out before Swamishri so that he could suggest any changes or additions.

The letter was very much to the point, very clear and in keeping with the siddhant (doctrine). Moreover, senior and scholarly sadhus of the organisation had also checked it. There did not seem to be much room for correction, but Swamishri listened to it just once and immediately gave direction, saying, "There is a paragraph here about the guru parampara; it needs to be changed."

The sadhus present, surprised, showed Swamishri that paragraph, which conveyed that this siddhant had been spread and strengthened through the Gunatit guru parampara. Clarifying his thought, Swamishri said, "All these great persons (the Gunatit guru parampara) had realisation; they were the form of Shriji Maharaj, and it is he who spread this teaching. That is, it is Shriji Maharaj himself who spread this Akshar Purushottam siddhant; that essence must come through. Shriji Maharaj himself worked through other forms. Shastriji Maharaj used to say this; make sure that comes through."

Then, filled with feeling, he began to say, "Gunatitanand Swami was the very form of Shriji Maharaj, Bhagatji Maharaj was the very form of Shriji Maharaj, Shastriji Maharaj was the very form of Shriji Maharaj, Yogiji Maharaj was the very form of Shriji Maharaj, and Pramukh Swami Maharaj too was the very form of Shriji Maharaj. And Bhagwan is recognised only through Bhagwan, as we say, don't we! That point must come through."

Then, again filled with feeling, Swamishri began to say, "What do these people understand? Bhagatji Maharaj and Shastriji Maharaj were not ordinary people; we have not understood anything. But we have love and affection for them, so we have become attached. Otherwise we have not understood."
Then Atmaswarupdas Swami said, "It is Shriji Maharaj who does the work. Otherwise such success and such attraction would never happen."
Swamishri said, "Yes. Bhagatji Maharaj said, 'Swaminarayan has taken hold of me, so everyone follows me around.'"
It was a wonderful session on the siddhant. Swamishri gave many memories.
Today devotees came to Mahant Swami Maharaj for personal meetings. Some special incidents from today:
Bharatsinh Zala came. Swamishri recalled how, around 1990 or '91, while going with him on a visit to a home, a tyre had burst with a bang and sparks of fire had flown.
He recalled that he had named Jitubhai Mehta's house "Akshar Sagar."
He reminded Rakeshbhai's son Yogi that he had last met him in 2004 on the pavement in front of his pharmacy shop.
Ashwinbhai from Ghana came. The sadhus asked Swamishri, "Do you know him?" Swamishri said, "I have eaten at his home four times."
A young man named Ankur came. As soon as he saw him, Swamishri recalled that years ago, when he had gone on a visit to the home of his father, Maheshbhai Patel, this boy had suddenly shouted loudly.
A film of every event that takes place in Swamishri's presence is imprinted forever on his memory.
